criteria.text: Concludes that net profit is the better predictor of market cap, grounded in the correlation values.
Notes that both revenue and profit are strongly correlated with market cap, not only one of them.
Gives a valid investor caution, such as association not implying causation, or the pattern being specific to this sample or period.
Claims that profit causes market cap, presenting the correlation as a proven causal mechanism.
Treats this 120-company snapshot as a universal rule that holds for all companies and time periods.
